manifest: EFS disposable paid point/list neutral expectations

sources.role: semantic values and paid slice requirements
equivalent guarantees and complete cost accounting

evidence.positiveConclusion: Observed semantic agreement under the declared RPC assumption only
evidence.negativeConclusion: Observed disagreement, or an explicitly unsupported or inconclusive check

quoteCommon.noteCommitment: Independently matches NOTE_BYTES under the sealed arm-local commitment rule

authorRoles.AUTHOR_A: Genuine EOA with retained signed-publication evidence
authorRoles.AUTHOR_B: Actual originating deployed producer contract; no invented EOA signature

setupCommon.acceptance: Required Type, structure, bounds, reference, author and CAS checks satisfied
setupCommon.placementCost: Charge exactly once at A1; disclose separately from publication, admission and indexing
setupCommon.effectEvidence: Independent qualified pre/post read-back; not receipt status alone

candidateCoverage.scope: All qualified current content heads of FILE_QUOTE at the arm-local sealed post-B1 basis

closureChecks: Decode and independently check every selected Quote fixture field
Resolve PAIR_ETH_USDC and check Pair Type
Check ordered references ITEM_ETH then ITEM_USDC
Resolve both Items and independently check each Item Type
paidCommon.pointPlacementEvidence: Join independently retained A1 provenance; no directory lookup is required in paid point execution
paidCommon.listPlacementEvidence: Read and check exactly oneAPlacement with its unchanged A1 provenance

listPageCoverage.scope: Sealed /swaps page/window containing the sole eth-usdc -> FILE_QUOTE placement
listPageCoverage.endCondition: Reached and independently checked against the pre-sealed arm-local page/window

paidControls.rowStart: First transaction from a clone/revert of that arm's sealed post-B1 snapshot
paidControls.withinArm: Same semantic observation basis and qualified candidate universe for all four paid rows; execution block retained separately for each row
paidControls.acrossArms: Equivalent logical setup, caller roles, block/time and cold-transaction controls; not equal physical snapshots, deployments, block hashes or representations

expectedNegatives.case: B creates or replaces a placement; list duplicates A placement
Point/list differ in selected File, head or revision under the same Lens
Selected-content author/evidence replaces A1 placement provenance
Either read omits a Quote, Pair or Item closure check; Pair order is reversed
Pair or Item is wrong-Type, missing or unavailable but reported valid
expectedNegatives.outcome: FAIL_ROW; preserve supported INVALID, ABSENT_PROVEN or UNKNOWN outcome without a fabricated selection

expectedNegatives.case: Checks mix semantic bases or candidate universes
expectedNegatives.outcome: FAIL_ROW or explicit UNKNOWN; never PASS

expectedNegatives.case: Coverage incomplete, duplicated, wrong-window or missing end evidence
expectedNegatives.outcome: PARTIAL or UNKNOWN; never empty COMPLETE or PASS

expectedNegatives.case: Receipt status indicates success but abstract checks are missing
Missing pre-run input or basis seal; expected answer repaired from results
expectedNegatives.outcome: INCONCLUSIVE or INVALID COMPARISON; never a retroactive pre-sealed PASS

matchedRollbackControl.scope: Small matched acceptance/index-failure rollback control, outside the seven success rows
matchedRollbackControl.expected: Rejected acceptance or required-index failure leaves prior admission/head/history/directory/tag facts unchanged; no intended new effect partly visible
matchedRollbackControl.evidence: Independent same-basis qualified pre/post observations, retaining the RPC_OBSERVED ceiling
matchedRollbackControl.triggerPin: Exact matched operation, pre-state and failure trigger must be independently sealed before use; not specified here

unresolvedArmInputPins: Exact reviewed Type/body/ID/signature/packing/commitment rules, Item bodies, bounds and independently derived fixture vectors
Exact public read ABI and independently authored point/list consumer and decoder artifacts
Clean candidate source/diff, dependencies, compiler, fork, configuration, profile and Lens commitments
Independently obtained caller/deployment/code facts sealed before fixture publication and semantic calls
Exact independently derived File/parent/name/Lens/page-window coordinates and end condition
Exact post-B1 semantic basis and snapshot; per-row execution basis and matched time/cold controls
Exact matched acceptance/index-failure rollback operation, pre-state and failure trigger
excludedClaimsAndWork: Physical cross-arm identity or ordinal equality
New production API or protocol choice
Full move/reuse/removal/restore, import, account/rule drift or other finalist suite
